name: agro-adm
description: Monorepo simples: backend (NestJS) + frontend (React SPA). Sem workspaces — cada projeto tem seu package.json e seu lockfile.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "yarn --cwd backend dev" "yarn --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: yarn --cwd backend build && yarn --cwd frontend build
scripts.install:all: yarn --cwd backend install && yarn --cwd frontend install
